name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: guards=$(git ls-files ':(glob)tests/**/*.py') || exit; [ -n "$guards" ] || { echo 'no tracked tests/**/*.py guards found' >&2; exit 1; }; rc=0; for f in $guards; do python3 -I "$f" || { echo "$f failed" >&2; rc=1; }; done; exit "$rc"
